# Content & Copy Reference

## Microcopy Standards
- Action-oriented labels: use direct verbs on buttons and calls to action (e.g., "Save changes", "Create project").
- Clarity over cleverness: error messages must state what went wrong and how to fix it.
- Placeholder text in inputs must provide example data, not repeat the label.
- Empty states must explain why the view is empty and provide a primary action to populate data.

## Tone & Hierarchy
- Maintain consistent voice across product surfaces (clear, direct, helpful).
- Heading hierarchy must reflect importance (`<h1>` to `<h4>`) without skipping levels.
- Tooltips and helper text must be concise and supplemental.
